subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the `read` tool get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file work?
rationale: The source-proven token-waste path remains, but choosing between warning fallback, automatic parsing, and broader file/document architecture changes product, security, and ownership boundaries that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Land Narrow Fallback
options.body: Repair or replace the linked guard so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear unsupported-file message while normal text and image reads keep working.

options.title: Fold Into Document Extraction
options.body: Keep this issue open as context for shared document extraction and require parser, dependency, resource-limit, and security decisions first.

options.title: Defer To Provider-Native File Design
options.body: Avoid a read-tool-specific fix and resolve document handling through the broader provider-native file/document forwarding design.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fallback
recommendation.body: Repair or replace the linked guard so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear unsupported-file message while normal text and image reads keep working.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-boundary decision, and steipete has the strongest combined signal from historical read-wrapper work plus prior review routing.
